Four anchored-structure families on 60m, 2024-10-06..2026-09-30, per symbol (MES MNQ MGC MCL). F1 anchored-VWAP +-k*sigma fade (7 anchors: rth open, 18:00 globex open, week open, month open, highest-volume bar of trailing 20 sessions, widest-range bar of trailing 20 sessions, 5-bar swing pivot; k in 0/1/2; warmups 5 and 3). F1b the same bands traded as continuation. F2 naked POC (session and weekly) as magnet and as fade, plus a 10-session revisit-rate test vs random prices in the same range. F3 Fibonacci 0.382/0.5/0.618/0.705/0.786 anchored at prior RTH session, prior week, overnight Globex range and an ATR-ZigZag impulse leg, traded with the impulse. F3b the same levels traded as trend-failure. F4 merged-timeframe LVN confluence (LVN on >=2 of 1-session/1-week/1-month/3-month 60m profiles within 0.25 ATR) traded as continuation, vs single-window LVNs. One geometry for every arm: next open +-1 tick, stop = level -+ (0.5 ATR14 + 1 tick), target 1.5R, 12-bar time exit, flat at session close, one position at a time. IS = first 60% (search, no claims), OOS = last 40% (one confirmation per family per symbol). 348 IS variants; 24 OOS tests; bar 2.521. Result: 0 of 24 pass. Best MGC F3b prior_week golden +0.4324R t +2.705 but shift-null z 2.49 < 2.521.

MGC 60m only. Prior calendar week's high/low; up-week means retracements 0.618/0.705/0.786 measured down from the high (mirror for a down week). In the 08:00-12:00 ET bars, a bar that trades into a level and CLOSES against the prior week's direction is entered at the next open in that against-the-week direction; stop = level -+ (0.5 ATR14 + 1 tick), target 1.5R, flat at session close. OOS n=33 +0.4324R t +2.705 win 66.7% payoff 1.54, halves +0.446/+0.419, direction placebo beaten 10/10, count-matched level placebo z +2.191, shift-null z +2.493 vs bar 2.521 - DOES NOT PASS. Median stop 20.4 points = $204 vs the $120 budget, so the account funded 6 of 33 trades.

OQ2 tested paired on identical trades, 60m, all four symbols. Entries deliberately unselected (every eligible RTH bar, direction fixed by the prior bar's close, both polarities) so the exit policy is the only variable. base = stop 0.5 ATR + tick, target 1.5R. be08 = stop to the fill once a bar trades +0.8R without touching the stop, effective next bar. x08 = full exit at +0.8R. RESULT: be08 does nothing - it changes only 4-7% of trades, four arms positive four negative, best paired t +1.74 (MGC mom) vs bar 2.327. x08 is reliably WORSE on 8/8 arms, paired t -3.12 to -8.60, costing 0.06-0.13R per trade while raising the win rate 5-8 pp. be08/x08 do cut drawdown: MES mom baseline peaks at $3,012 dd against the $2,800 floor (account dead), x08 holds $2,563.

OQ6 on MES and MNQ 1440m, 1865 bars, 2019-05-03..2026-09-29, roll-clean (largest gap 8.92% = Mar 2020). B1: close above the highest close of the prior 20 sessions -> long, mirror short; stop 1 ATR14, target 2R, 10-bar time exit. B2: close beyond a 2-sigma band of a 20-session mean -> revert. RESULT: B1 OOS MES n=70 +0.1113R t +0.701 (halves +0.325/-0.102), MNQ n=65 +0.1310R t +0.777 (halves +0.108/+0.153 - the only arm in either study with both halves positive and similar); both beat the direction placebo 10/10, shift z +1.37/+1.36; neither clears the 2.327 bar. B2 fails on both (MES +0.0187R, MNQ -0.1159R). CRITICAL: the $120 risk budget funded 1 of 252 trades across all four arms - a 1-ATR daily index stop is ~$300-400/contract. Unfundable, not merely unproven.

OQ5 retest on MCL 240m and 60m. Rule: a bar closes beyond the prior 3-bar range in the direction of the 10-bar net move -> enter next open with the move, stop 1 ATR, target 1.5R, 12-bar time exit. RESULT: DOES NOT REPLICATE the parked '97% of observations positive, t 2.97'. 60m loses in-sample (n=270, -0.1327R, t -2.145) AND out-of-sample (n=174, -0.0879R, t -1.163). 240m loses in-sample (n=197, -0.1192R) and goes mildly positive out-of-sample (n=135, +0.0521R, t +0.496) - a sign flip, not a confirmation. OQ5 retired.

OQ3 moved from 30m to 60m (30m holds only 2013 bars; deviation declared in the pre-registration before running). Prior RTH session's 60m profile; price tags VAH and closes back inside -> short with target = the prior session POC, mirror at VAL; stop beyond the edge by 0.5 ATR + 1 tick. RESULT: in-sample n=164 -0.2259R t -3.713, out-of-sample n=91 +0.0148R t +0.144 - a complete sign flip. Win rate 54.9% with payoff 0.85, i.e. a majority of winners earning nothing. The direction placebo averaged +0.2553R and the real rule beat it 1 time in 10. OQ3 retired.

DIAGNOSTIC, NOT a confirmation and not counted: the rule was selected on these same out-of-sample bars, so re-scoring them cannot establish significance and no expectancy figure from this arm may be quoted as evidence. Question asked was mechanical only - does a resting limit at the level make ANCH1_MGC_fib_trend_failure fundable? RESULT: YES. Market entry at next open +-1 tick gives a median stop of 20.41 MGC points = $204 against the $120 budget, funding 6 of 33 trades. A resting limit at the level gives a median stop of 10.38 points = $104, inside the budget, funding 16 of 26 trades; 18 signals expire unfilled. Significance still requires bars this study has not seen.

CORRECTION to PERSYM1_MGC_fib_limit_entry_DIAGNOSTIC, same day. A fill-bar look-ahead inflated every limit-entry expectancy figure: a resting limit fills mid-bar and an OHLC bar does not say whether the high preceded the low, and the engine credited the 1.5R target on the fill bar, assuming the favourable ordering. On a test arm 153 of 304 trades (50.3%) booked their target that way. Fixed in workspace/anchors/lib/core.py _walk: the fill bar now allows only the adverse outcome. RESTATED: MGC prior-week golden limit OOS +0.2379R t +1.027 n=24 (published as +0.6060R t +2.88); funded 14 of 24 (published 16 of 26); median stop $106 (published $104). The FUNDING conclusion stands - $204 market vs $106 limit, 6 of 33 vs 14 of 24 fundable - because that is geometry, not path. The trade-off reverses: the limit is affordable and WEAKER per unit of risk (t +1.027 vs +2.705 market), not affordable and stronger. Also killed a candidate that never existed: MNQ overnight-shallow fib trend-failure read +0.3358R t +2.940 OOS under the bug and reads -0.0240R t -0.213 after it. Tracks A-D used market entries and are unaffected.
